An '''Imperial lieutenant''' commanded a squad of [[Imperial soldier]]s during the [[Galactic War]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He guided an Imperial boarding party tasked with attacked a crashed [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]], home of the [[White Maw]], in an attempt to eliminate the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] captain [[Valon (pirate)|Valon]], but met [[the Barsen'thor]]. The [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant's]] unit had been tasked with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Valon in return for the pirate betraying the Empire after they gave him the [[regenerative armor]].
